}}{{TIDTOC|embedded}} ==Overview== Default settings are per '''Micronet''''s manual. :The sample SSID specified in the manual is ''wireless''. The OUIs used are 00:05:B4 (''Aceex'') for WAN/LAN and 02:05:B4 for WLAN. :Both OUIs have a fair number of ''wireless'' SSIDs attributed to them in ''WiGLE'' DB.
